Hana (CS): Heads-up — running an alpha-preview office-hours block next week for 6 pilot teams. Goal: validate the enrolment flow, capture blocker signals, and test the post-call follow-up playbook. Need invites, 1 note-taker per slot, and someone to triage renewal-risk flags.
Diego (PM): Proposed block Wed 9-12 PT, 30-min slots. We'll track Time-to-First-Success and an "activation confidence" 1-5. Can Pri own the infra slot?
Pri (SE): I can take Wed 10:00. I will bring a 1-pager with SSO/SAML/SCIM quick fixes and a snippet for Okta: `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true`. Also note for air-gapped demos: `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.
Zoe (Research): For capture, let's use a 7-question micro-survey + a 3-question quick-check at the end of the call (LTR 1-5, deal-breaker Y/N, free text). I'll post the form and the call rubric: https://forms.redwood.com/alpha-officehours-2025
Hana (CS): Owners: Hana = invites + post-call Loom, Pri = SSO + rapid remediation doc, Zoe = survey + export, Diego = compile highlights & flag renewal risks (SSO, data residency, perf). Need one volunteer to tag quotes during notes.
Pri (SE): Quick SAML tip for enterprise customers: ensure AssertionConsumerService uses https and set `NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress`. I'll paste the exact YAML before the calls.
Diego (PM): If activation confidence <=2 or deal-breaker = yes -> immediate renewal-risk tag. P0 infra items get runtime-oncall ping with a 48h SLA. We'll include a simple triage card template in the follow-up.
OnboardBot: Calendar batch created: Alpha Preview Office Hours  Wed 2025-06-25 09:00-12:00 PT. Slots: 30-min x6. Attendees prefilled: Hana, Diego, Pri, Zoe. Meet links attached.
Hana (CS): Post-call flow: 1) Loom recap + micro-survey within 24h, 2) survey export + quotes (Zoe), 3) compile top-3 friction items and map to quick-wins vs backlog (Diego). If legal/data residency questions appear, tag as enterprise signal and loop Legal + Sales immediately.
Zoe (Research): I'll add a consent checkbox to the survey for quotes/case-study opt-in. Also will tag any recurring friction across slots so we can prioritize.
Pri (SE): I'll prepare a 2-slide "Known gotchas & workaround commands" doc and include a debug command for provisioning logs: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-demo | grep provision`.
Hana (CS): Need one person to own immediate customer follow-ups for any renewal-risk flags (SSO failure, region/KMS concerns, throughput). Who can take that?
Diego (PM): I can triage renewal-risk flags during the day and create backlog cards for anything non-blocking. For infra P0s, I'll ping runtime-oncall and Sales.
Hana (CS): Great. I'll post the roster + owner checklist in ~15m. If anyone else wants to observe a slot, ping me — these calls are short but high-signal. :sparkles:
